field.label: Filter searches by selected delivery area
field.comment: Uses X-Hub-Country, X-Hub-Region, X-Hub-City and X-Hub-Locality request headers. Apply only to uncached POST requests. Requires complete warehouse and coverage setup.

field.label: Use Hub fulfillment at checkout
field.comment: Requires installed fulfillment tables, mapped sources, complete coverage/rates and verified shipping/accounting integration. Replaces existing shipping offers. Keep disabled until isolated acceptance passes.

field.label: Enable preview API
field.comment: Does not change checkout, reserve stock, book carriers or post settlements. Configure a valid policy first.

field.label: Versioned fulfillment policy (JSON)
field.comment: Administrator configuration of source ownership, vendor defaults, product overrides and origin/destination rates. See the module README and example policy. Monetary values are integer minor units, excluding tax. No real rates are supplied by default.
